The vendor directly providing **Komoot** at **komoot.com** is **komoot GmbH**.

* **Privacy Policy:** Explicitly identifies the controller and responsible operating company: *"Responsible for processing your personal data: komoot GmbH. Friedrich-Wilhelm-Boelcke-Straße 2 14473 Potsdam."*
